Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.The global shift towards renewable energy is reshaping the energy landscape and addressing urgent environmental challenges. Solar, wind, and hydropower are leading the way as sustainable alternatives to fossil fuels, offering significant benefits such as reducing greenhouse gas emissions and slowing climate change. Advancements in technology have dramatically lowered the costs of renewable energy production, making it more accessible and attractive to governments, businesses, and individuals. Countries worldwide are setting ambitious targets to expand their renewable energy capacities, driven by environmental imperatives and the economic opportunities presented by the green energy sector.However, the transition to renewable energy is not without obstacles. One major challenge is energy storage. Since solar and wind power depend on weather conditions, their intermittent nature makes it difficult to ensure a steady energy supply. Developing efficient, scalable, and affordable storage solutions, such as advanced battery systems, is critical to overcoming this hurdle. Additionally, integrating renewable energy into existing power grids requires substantial infrastructure upgrades to manage fluctuating power inputs effectively.Despite these challenges, the momentum behind renewable energy continues to grow. Innovations like floating solar farms, offshore wind farms, and green hydrogen are expanding the boundaries of what renewable technologies can achieve. Furthermore, policy support, public awareness, and private investment are driving the adoption of clean energy at an unprecedented pace. As these advancements unfold, renewable energy is poised to redefine the future of global energy systems, paving the way for a cleaner, more sustainable, and resilient world.What does the passage primarily discuss?
options: The superiority of renewable energy over fossil fuels
The economic challenges of renewable energy
The role of governments in reducing greenhouse gas emissions
The advancements and challenges in the transition to renewable energy
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The advancements and challenges in the transition to renewable energy) है।

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Nutrition plays a pivotal role in maintaining health and preventing chronic diseases. A balanced diet provides the essential nutrients that the body needs to function properly. These nutrients include carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins and minerals, each serving a specific purpose in the body's complex systems. Carbohydrates are the body's primary energy source, fueling daily activities and brain function. Proteins are essential for growth, repair and maintenance of tissues. Fats, despite their negative reputation, are crucial for energy storage, insulation and protecting vital organs. Vitamins and minerals, though required in smaller quantities, are vital for various biochemical processes. For instance, Vitamin C is essential for immune function and skin health, while calcium is necessary for strong bones and teeth. A deficiency in these nutrients can lead to various health issues. For example, lack of iron can cause anaemia, characterised by fatigue and weakness, while insufficient Vitamin D can result in bone disorders such as rickets in children and osteomalacia in adults. A healthy diet also involves proper hydration. Water is critical for digestion, nutrient transport and temperature regulation.Dehydration can lead to serious health problems, including kidney stones and urinary tract infections. Additionally, fibre, found in fruits, vegetables and whole grains, aids in digestion and helps prevent constipation and other digestive issues. Maintaining a balanced diet can help prevent chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes and obesity. Consuming a variety of nutrient-rich foods, while limiting the intake of processed foods, sugars and unhealthy fats, is key to long-term health. Regular physical activity complements good nutrition by helping to maintain a healthy weight, improve cardiovascular health and enhance overall well-being. In conclusion, nutrition is fundamental to health. A well-balanced diet, rich in essential nutrients and proper hydration, supports bodily functions and prevents diseases. Making informed dietary choices is crucial for a healthy and fulfilling life.What is the primary energy source for the body?

Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Throughout history, consciousness has remained an enigmatic phenomenon, resisting comprehensive scientific and philosophical explanations. While neuroscience attempts to map consciousness to neural activity, philosophers argue that subjective experience—often referred to as the hard problem of consciousness—cannot be entirely reduced to physical processes. This dilemma has given rise to various theories, each attempting to decipher the nature of awareness.One school of thought, physicalism, asserts that consciousness emerges solely from brain activity and can eventually be explained through neurobiological mechanisms. Functionalism extends this view, positing that mental states are defined by their function rather than their physical composition, allowing for the possibility of artificial intelligence achieving consciousness.Conversely, dualism suggests a fundamental separation between mind and matter, with thinkers like Descartes proposing that consciousness exists independently of the physical brain. More radical theories, such as panpsychism, argue that consciousness is a fundamental property of the universe, present in all matter at varying degrees. Recent advancements in cognitive science propose integrated theories, such as the Global Workspace Theory (GWT), which suggests that consciousness arises from the brain integrating and broadcasting information across different neural networks. Meanwhile, the Integrated Information Theory (IIT) attempts to quantify consciousness by measuring a system’s ability to integrate information.Despite these advancements, a fundamental question persists: Is consciousness an emergent property of complex computation, or does it transcend physical explanation? The search for answers continues to challenge the boundaries of science and philosophy. As interdisciplinary research deepens, the mystery of consciousness continues to inspire both awe and debate. Perhaps unlocking its secrets will require not just scientific innovation, but a paradigm shift in how we perceive reality itself.What is the tone of the passage?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Analytical and thought-provoking) है।

options: ताकि उसे वर्तमान समय की प्रवृत्तियों और शैलियों का बोध हो।

Comprehension:दिए गए गद्यांंश के आधार पर निम्नांकित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए-- वह मेज पर सिर रखे सो रहा था। एक लिखा हुआ कागज मेज पर खुला पड़ा था। व्यापारी ने वह कागज उठाया, लिखा था "कल 12 बजे मैं आज़ाद हो जाऊंगा। लेकिन अब मुझे आज़ादी नहीं चाहिए, ज़िंदगी नहीं चाहिए, वह सब कुछ जिन्हें तुम अच्छी चीजें कहते हो, मुझे नहीं चाहिए। पन्द्रह साल तक मैंने इस धरती की ज़िंदगी को देखा परखा है।  किताबों में मैंने मदिरा पी, गीत गाये, जंगलों में घूमा, शिकार किये, सुन्दर औरतों से प्यार किया। पहाड़ों की ऊंचाई छुई, आंधी तूफान देखे, शहर, दरिया, झीलें और समुद्र देखे। चरवाहों का मधुर संगीत सुना। शैतान और भगवान से बातें की। मैं अन्तहीन अंधेरे गड्‌ढों में गया, चमत्कार किये, हत्याएं की, शहर जलाए, नये धर्मों का प्रचार किया, प्रदेश जीते और राज्य स्थापित किये। सारे युगों का विचार तत्व मेरे मस्तिष्क में समाहित है। मैं तुम सबसे अधिक जानता हूँ। तुम सब कल नहीं रहोगे। रहने लायक, पाने लायक कुछ है ही नहीं। कल समय से पहले ही मैं यहां से निकल जाऊंगा। मैं तुम्हें शर्त से आज़ाद करता हूँ।" व्यापारी ने उस कागज को चुपचाप मेज पर रख दिया और बाहर चला आया।निम्नलिखित में से मधुर शब्द का विलोम शब्द पहचानें।

questions.question: Comprehension:निम्नलिखित गद्यांश ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।लघुत्व से महत्त्व की और बढ़ना स्वाभिमान होने की निशानी है जबकि महत्त्व मिलने पर दूसरों को लघु समझना अभिमानी होने का प्रमाण है। अभिमान में व्यक्ति अपना प्रदर्शन कर दूसरों को नीचा दिखाने की कोशिश करता है इसलिए लोग उससे दूर रहना चाहते हैं। सिर्फ़ चाटुकार लोग ही अपने स्वार्थ के कारण उसकी वाहवाही करते हैं। इसके विपरीत स्वाभिमानी व्यक्ति दूसरों के विचारों को महत्त्व देता है ।एक जगह बाढ़ आई थी समाजसेवी संस्थाएँ बाढ़ पीड़ितों को सहायता का वितरण कर रही थीं कुछ स्वयंसेवकों ने एक वृद्धा की झोपड़ी में पहुँच कर उसे सहायता देने का प्रस्ताव रखा। उसने बड़े प्रेम से मना कर दिया। बोली—बेटा मैं पिछले बीस वर्षों से अपनी मेहनत की कमाई खा रही हूँ, मुझे आपकी सहायता नहीं चाहिए। स्वयंसेवक अवाक् थे एवं उस वृद्धा के स्वाभिमान के आगे नतमस्तक।स्वाभिमान व्यक्ति को स्वावलम्बी बनाता है जबकि अभिमानी हमेशा दूसरों पर आश्रित रहना चाहता है।  इन दोनों का मिश्रण व्यक्तित्व को बहुत जटिल बना देता है। दूसरों को कमतर आँकना एवं स्वयं को बड़ा समझना अभिमान है।प्रस्तुत गद्यांश का उचित शीर्षक क्या है?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (स्वाभिमान और अभिमान) है।
